character: Small hamlet below St-Martin-de-Belleville at 1,200m. Quiet residential hamlet with traditional Savoyard stone architecture. Access to ski area via St-Martin gondola (5 min drive). Peaceful, good-value base.
dining: Local bar. Restaurant access in St-Martin.
activities_nearby: Snowshoeing, hiking in the valley. Drive + shuttle to 3 Vallées ski area.
